dimensions.name: Education
anchors: School/major weakly related to target field; GPA missing or clearly low
Decent school/major, but no targeted fit with the field (e.g., relevant courses, minor)
School/major broadly aligned with target field; above-average grades
Strong school tier, highly relevant major, excellent grades or relevant minor/coursework
Top-tier school/program, major highly aligned with target field, highly compelling transcript

dimensions.name: Internship / Work Experience
dimensions.desc: Relevance, depth of responsibilities, quantified outcomes
anchors: No internship/work experience, or experience entirely unrelated to target field
Has internship experience, but descriptions stay at menial-task level with no quantified outcomes
1-2 relevant internships with clear responsibilities and some outcome descriptions
Multiple relevant internships with progressive responsibilities and quantified outcomes (e.g., improved X%, saved Y hours)
Relevant internships at well-known/leading organizations, deep responsibilities, outstanding and verifiable outcomes

dimensions.name: Projects
dimensions.desc: Technical/methodological depth, personal contribution, real impact
anchors: No independent projects, or projects unrelated to the target field's tech/methods
Course projects only; shallow technical depth, unclear team role
1-2 relevant projects with appropriate tech/method use and basic outcomes
Projects show complexity and innovation, clear personal contribution, real impact or output
Projects near production-grade or with real impact (published, launched, awarded, adopted)

dimensions.name: Skills & Tools
dimensions.desc: Coverage of core field skills, with evidence
anchors: Skill list barely relevant to target field, or just a list with no evidence
Basic relevant skills, but no usage context as evidence
Covers core tools of the target field, backed by projects/experience
Comprehensive and deep skill coverage, corroborated across multiple experiences
Skill set clearly beyond peers, involving cutting-edge tools/methods in the field

dimensions.name: Certifications & Exams
anchors: No relevant certifications/exam scores
Basic certificates, but modest prestige or relevance
At least one recognized credential or qualifying exam score relevant to the target field
Multiple highly relevant certifications, or excellent core exam scores
Holds widely recognized high-value credential(s) in the field with advanced progress

dimensions.name: Leadership & Extracurriculars
dimensions.desc: Organizational involvement, leadership roles, tangible outcomes
anchors: No extracurricular or leadership experience
Some participation, but marginal role with no tangible output
Some organizational involvement or small-scope responsibilities
Led a student organization/project with concrete outcomes
High-caliber leadership with broad impact, or outcomes recognized externally

dimensions.name: Resume Presentation
anchors: Disorganized formatting, unclear language, unfocused keyword stuffing
Basically readable, but lacks quantification and uses repetitive verbs
Clear structure, most bullets have some quantification and focus
Clear structure, precise wording, strong quantification, highlights stand out
Professional presentation, tight logic - close to a submission-ready model resume

fields.name: Software Engineer
bonus: Active GitHub / open-source contributions
Strong competitive programming record (ICPC / LeetCode contests, etc.)
Production deployment experience
Relevant internship at a top tech company
gaps: Only coursework-level projects; lacks system design thinking
No evidence of code quality / engineering standards
Long tech stack list with no real projects to back it up

fields.name: Data Scientist
bonus: Published paper or preprint
Placed in a well-known data competition (e.g., Kaggle)
Lab research experience
Can explain business conclusions with data; presented to non-technical teams
gaps: Only tutorial / starter notebooks; lacks originality
Math/statistics foundation not evident in resume
Projects show model metrics but no business impact or real-world decisions

fields.name: Machine Learning Engineer
bonus: Model deployment / serving experience
Hands-on projects with mainstream deep learning frameworks
Distributed training or large-scale data processing experience
Contributed to open-source ML projects or tooling
gaps: Only tutorial / starter notebooks; lacks originality
Projects lack reproducible evaluation metrics
No engineering/deployment experience; stuck at notebook stage

fields.name: Hardware Engineer
bonus: End-to-end hardware/system project from design to implementation
Won a recognized engineering competition
Relevant lab / factory internship
gaps: Projects stay at simulation/theory level; no physical validation
Team role and individual contribution unclear
No consideration of cost/reliability engineering constraints

fields.name: Cybersecurity Engineer
bonus: CTF placements or bug bounty track record
Holds or pursuing Security+/CEH/OSCP etc.
Hands-on pentesting or security audit projects
Contributed to open-source security tools or disclosed CVEs
gaps: Only tutorial / target-range practice; no real-environment experience
Lists many security tools with no concrete usage context
No concrete incident response or analysis cases

fields.name: Robotics / Automation Engineer
bonus: Placed in robotics competitions (e.g., FRC/VEX/RoboMaster)
End-to-end robot/automation system from design to deployment
Hands-on ROS or embedded systems projects
Cross-disciplinary (mechanical+electronics+software) collaboration
gaps: Simulation/theory only; no physical build experience
Descriptions lean theoretical; no concrete debugging/iteration process
Lacks full-stack software-hardware system experience

fields.name: FinTech Engineer
bonus: Built real financial business systems (trading/payments/risk)
Hands-on high-concurrency or low-latency system design
Quant trading or financial data processing projects
Contributed to blockchain or payments open-source projects
gaps: Projects are generic software dev; no fintech business understanding
Course projects only; no production-grade system experience
No demonstrated awareness of financial compliance/risk basics

fields.name: Investment Banking Analyst
bonus: Internship at a top investment bank / fund
CFA / FRM progress well ahead
Business case or modeling competition wins
Solid financial modeling portfolio
gaps: Internship experience mostly supportive; little analytical output
No demonstrated ongoing market/industry engagement
Lacks quantified project/modeling outcomes

fields.name: Risk Analyst
bonus: Concrete credit or market risk modeling project experience
Holds or pursuing FRM/CFA
Proficient in Python/R/SQL for risk data analysis
Stress testing or regulatory reporting internship
gaps: Projects are generic data analysis; no risk-specific application
Lists risk theory with no actual modeling/analysis cases
No demonstrated knowledge of regulatory frameworks (Basel/CCAR)

fields.name: Actuary
bonus: Passed multiple SOA/CAS actuarial exams
Actuarial internship experience
Proficient in SQL/R/Python for actuarial modeling
Actuarial club/competition involvement with results
gaps: Only mentions preparing for exams; no passed exams specified
Lacks concrete quantitative modeling or data analysis projects
No demonstrated understanding of insurance/risk pricing business

fields.name: Consultant
bonus: Top consulting firm internship or case competition win
Led a large student organization/project
Concrete cases of structured problem-solving
gaps: Leadership experience listed but lacking quantified, results-oriented expression
Resume narrative lacks structure (weak STAR usage)
No cross-domain / cross-functional collaboration experience

fields.name: Marketing
bonus: Ran a campaign independently with data-backed results
Proficient with analytics/ad tools (GA, SEM, etc.)
Content creation / social media growth results
gaps: Experience mostly execution-level; little strategy/data analysis
Lacks quantified growth/conversion data
No demonstrated insight into target users/markets

fields.name: Product Manager
bonus: Led a 0-to-1 product/feature
Concrete data-driven decision cases
Cross-functional edge from technical or design background
gaps: Experience leans operations/execution; little product thinking
No user research or data-backed decision cases
No demonstrated understanding of business metrics

fields.name: Business Analyst
bonus: Completed end-to-end analysis projects turned into business recommendations
Hands-on SQL/Python/Tableau or Power BI with real cases
Concrete A/B testing or data-driven decision experience
gaps: Experience is mostly data pulling/cleaning; no full chain from data to business recommendation
Lacks quantified analytical outcomes or business impact
Tool usage is a list with no concrete application context

fields.name: Supply Chain Management
bonus: Led process optimization with quantified efficiency/cost improvements
Concrete cross-department/team coordination cases
Familiar with supply chain/ERP systems (e.g., SAP) with hands-on use
gaps: Experience is routine execution tasks; little proactive improvement
Lacks quantified cost/efficiency metrics
No concrete cross-functional collaboration cases

fields.name: Data Analyst
bonus: Built dashboards / automated reports independently
Strong SQL with complex multi-table join cases
Concrete cases of statistics-backed business conclusions
gaps: Long tool list with no project evidence of depth
Analysis stays descriptive; no business insight or recommendations
No demonstrated care for data accuracy / metric consistency

fields.name: Accountant / Auditor
bonus: Many CPA/ACCA subjects passed or ahead of schedule
Big Four or reputable firm internship
Concrete cases of independently completing audit workpapers / financial analysis
gaps: Internship was basic checking/data entry; little analytical work
Exam progress unclear or low-prestige
No demonstrated rigor on standards/compliance details

fields.name: Human Resources
bonus: Led recruiting / employee relations projects with concrete results
HR lead role in a student organization
Familiar with HRIS or people analytics
gaps: Experience is mostly administrative; little involvement in core HR functions
No concrete cross-department communication or conflict cases
No demonstrated people-data analysis awareness

fields.name: Sales
bonus: Quantified sales performance (met/exceeded quota)
Hands-on CRM experience (e.g., Salesforce)
Concrete cold outreach or account management cases
gaps: Mostly supportive roles; no independent ownership of accounts or targets
Lacks quantified performance/conversion data
No demonstrated communication/persuasion evidence

fields.name: Lawyer
bonus: Top law firm / court internship
Moot court / legal writing competition wins
Bar exam passed or well ahead
gaps: Internship was mostly clerical; little substantive legal work
No concrete evidence of legal writing/research ability
No demonstrated sustained interest in a specific practice area

fields.name: Clinical Research Associate
bonus: GCP training certificate or clinical research certification
Hands-on clinical trial/research project experience
Familiar with IRB review process or CRF completion
Data verification or QC experience
gaps: Only lab research; no clinical/patient-facing experience
No demonstrated understanding of GCP/FDA compliance
Lacks evidence of meticulous documentation ability

fields.name: Media / PR
bonus: Work published/broadcast with audience proof
Ran a social media account independently with growth data
Well-known media/PR company internship
gaps: No portfolio or dead links; ability unverifiable
Mostly assisting roles; no lead creative cases
No data-driven understanding of audience/reach

fields.name: Film Producer
bonus: Complete work screened at festivals/platforms or awarded
Independently managed budget and crew for a full project
On-set internship / crew experience
Professional skill in editing/cinematography/lighting with real cases
gaps: Only coursework-level shorts; no real set experience
Unclear roles/responsibilities (many credits, little contribution detail)

Proficient in Figma with collaborative project experience

Proficient in Revit/Rhino/AutoCAD/Grasshopper with real projects
Real built-project involvement or firm internship
Cross-disciplinary (structure/sustainable design) collaboration
